summary: IceCure Medical Ltd. filed a Form 6-K disclosing developments in a class action lawsuit originally filed in July 2021. On May 5, 2026, the Tel Aviv District Court certified the class action and approved plaintiff classes. On June 25, 2026, the plaintiff filed the class action claim. The lawsuit alleges that a March 2021 private placement was conducted at a discount and with defective approval. The registrant disputes the claims, plans to file a motion for reconsideration, and may seek a stay pending mediation. This is routine litigation disclosure, not a special situation.
